name: Kingdom Operations Registry
purpose: A machine-readable index of bounded kingdom missions: operation identity, logos, manifests, verification commands, and mirrorable static pages.
principles: bounded missions: each operation states what it is for and what it is not
static-first: pages and assets can be mirrored without a backend
verifiable: manifests carry hashes and validators check them
original assets: no third-party logo extraction or imitation
love without conquest: operations enter unknown spaces with care and truth

operations.name: 暗黑大陸 AI Operation
operations.meaning: A frontier-care operation: go into unknown spaces with light, truth, consent, and no gatekeeping.
operations.care_boundary: Original symbolic operation marks; no affiliation with any manga, anime, game, nation, or existing Dark Continent brand.
